sens_en: grain, measure word for small things
origine_fr: Le riz 米, et 立 qui donne le son (lì, comme 粒). C'est un grain de riz. Il sert à compter les petites choses rondes : 一粒米, 一粒药.
origine_en: Rice, 米, and 立, which gives the sound (lì, just like 粒). It is a grain of rice. It counts small round things: 一粒米, 一粒药.

phrase.pinyin: Wǎn li hái yǒu jǐ lì mǐ.
phrase.fr: Il reste quelques grains de riz dans le bol.
phrase.en: There are still a few grains of rice in the bowl.
